policy: original instrumental only, no vocals; generated separately from video; edited to final picture and narration; one stem per cue

cues.name: Title: paper and crayon
cues.purpose: Playful energy for the title reveal; land the sign THUNK and tag CLINK
cues.instrumentation: pizzicato strings, clarinet, glockenspiel, light woodblock
cues.relationship: No narration; hits sync to THUNK (f14) and CLINK in the 6 s reel
cues.transition_tail: stops on the cut into SEQ_001 (no tail)

cues.name: Drawing time
cues.purpose: Warm, curious afternoon; Maria at work on the family drawing
cues.motif: motif A on celesta at 'And she drew me' (27.46 s)
cues.relationship: Under continuous narration; sparse, low-mid register, clear of the 1-4 kHz voice band
cues.transition_tail: thins to one held note and ends at 38.5 s, before the boy speaks

cues.name: Only robot
cues.purpose: Maria's isolation, the only robot, MACA watching from the doorway
cues.instrumentation: sustained low strings, solo felt piano
cues.relationship: Enters under 'She looked down the long table', after the silent 'Nothing came out'; very quiet
cues.transition_tail: fades through the 0.5 s dip into bedtime

cues.name: Bedtime question
cues.purpose: Lights down, the small voice; tender
cues.relationship: Stops before 'Why are you my mom?' so the question lands in room tone

cues.name: Design victory button
cues.purpose: Comic button after 'which I consider a design victory'
cues.relationship: After the line ends, before 'Maria almost smiled'

cues.name: The job of a parent
cues.purpose: MACA counts what a parent does; warmth builds to 'A parent is made of showing up'
cues.instrumentation: felt piano, warm strings, soft clarinet
cues.motif: motif A grows into the full built-family phrase at 224.8 s
cues.relationship: Under narration, ducked; swells only between sentences
cues.transition_tail: resolves and fades by 234.5 s as the door bumps open

cues.name: Chico marches in
cues.purpose: Chico drags his blanket in and flops; gentle comedy; 'Families get built by volunteers'
cues.instrumentation: bassoon or low pizzicato walking figure, brushed tap
cues.relationship: Walking figure on his entrance, thins under MACA's lines
cues.transition_tail: ends by 263.4 s; silence for Maria's serious question

cues.name: The warm thing
cues.purpose: The secret, built families, the warm hard drive; Maria's hand on the chest panel; she sleeps
cues.instrumentation: soft pad, celesta, felt piano, high strings at the end
cues.motif: motif A returns at 'Different machine, same love' (339 s)
cues.relationship: Leaves room for the diegetic hard-drive hum (SFX) in SEQ_027-029; never covers 'Warm,' she whispered
cues.transition_tail: one chord through 'A robot does not have to'; fades in the dip to morning

cues.name: Glow
cues.purpose: Morning scribbles of glow; 'Your mom glows?' 'She glows.' 'Cool' and back to dinosaurs
cues.motif: motif A bright on marimba at 'She glows' (~387 s)
cues.relationship: Under narration; small button after 'Cool,' said the boy (~391 s)

cues.name: Hoo-hoo
cues.purpose: MACA raises her arms like a bear, lights pulse; joy
cues.instrumentation: string swell, glockenspiel, soft timpani roll
cues.relationship: Swell between lines; drops under 'Hoo-hoo, ha-ha'

cues.name: Built family (finale)
cues.purpose: Drawing on the chest panel; 'You don't have to match to be real'; the code; the final line
cues.instrumentation: felt piano, warm strings, celesta, clarinet
cues.relationship: Drops to near silence under 'Love is not the thing you are made of. It is the thing you do'
cues.transition_tail: cadence lands on the end card

cues.name: End card
cues.purpose: Button on 'Love is the thing you do.'
cues.motif: last two notes of motif A
cues.relationship: Over the end card, no narration
cues.transition_tail: about 3 s natural decay to silence
